name: Ramona Petri Dish Insert 85 mm
author: Ramona Optics
notes: A 85 mm petri dish in Ramona Optics' 3D printed petri dish insert, described as a well plate with one well so the existing labware tools (the full coverage scan, well labels, the plate viewer) can image a dish. The size is the outer diameter of the dish's base, not its lid: a 100 mm dish usually has a 90 mm base. It is the 'Well Plate Insert 85 mm Straight' STL, for the MCAM inserts page (web_reference, drawing_reference): a 127.76 x 85.48 x 5.0 mm plate with 0.5 mm corners (skirt_outline), so it fits well plate holders as a well plate does, and stands in the MCAM's well plate holder in place of one. GEOMETRY, measured off the STL: the insert is 5.0 mm thick with, centred on it, a pocket 90 mm across and 3.0 mm deep that the dish drops into, over a through hole 80 mm across; the dish rests on the 2.0 mm high ledge between them. The 90 mm pocket is wider than the 85.48 mm plate, so it breaks through the long sides, and the dish spills past the footprint; upper_outline is the dish clipped to it. The dish can sit up to 2.5 mm off centre in its pocket. THE WELL is the inside of the dish, centred on the pocket (A1 is the plate's centre). Nothing about the dish itself is published, so it is ASSUMED to be a common polystyrene dish: 1.0 mm walls and a 1.0 mm bottom, so the well's floor ('diameter') is 83 mm across, and 15 mm tall (60 x 15 and 100 x 15 mm dishes), so the plate height is the 2.0 mm ledge plus the dish. The scan covers the 83 mm floor; the through hole under it is 80 mm, so under transmitted light from below only that much of the dish is lit. For a different dish, only depth, height and the bottom keys change; the scan does not. The outline above the insert (upper_outline) is the dish; the skirt is the insert itself, 5.0 mm tall and solid but for the hole, which the skirt keys cannot say, so skirt_thickness is left at the standard. pitch is the dish size: with one well it only has to be wider than the well. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
